title: job event: done
description: Terminal frame of a job. The bench releases its job lock as soon as this frame is sent. May arrive before the hub has finished sending an image (a refusal). A failed done always names its error code; a request the bench will not act on is BENCH_PARAM_REJECTED.

rc.description: Tool exit code; -1 when the tool did not run or was killed.

stdout.description: Last 65536 characters of the tool's stdout.

stderr.description: Last 65536 characters of the tool's stderr.

error.description: Human-readable reason; empty when ok. At most 4096 characters, cut by the sender.

code.description: Empty when ok, an error code otherwise.

data.description: Structured result of builtin ops. Shape differs per op and is not described in v2.
